description: Independent review of package v4.1. The reviewer is a fresh, read-only Claude Code subagent given the sources, the brief and the compiler, not the author's conclusions. The record is written by the package author from the reviewer's report; it is not an authenticated attestation (as v4 residual RV3-2).

findings.remediation: T19 depends on T12 again; X13 now requires every v4 transitive ordering unless an owner-decided waiver names it; the scope test asserts T12 before T19

findings.finding: Contract and machine test work not budgeted; transition count wrong

findings.finding: Confirmation constructible from any file in the persistence namespace

findings.remediation: New assertions for each stated invariant: scroll regions accessible, line length, focus order, skip link first, dialog focus (open, trap, Escape, return), non-text contrast, forced colours, amber with a label, indicator composition, fault states what was preserved, navigation collapse; focusVisible requires a non-transparent ring of the focus-ring width that the blurred element lacks; textNotClipped detects vertical clipping and line-clamp; onlyFormaTokens reads document.styleSheets and style attributes. The reviewer's 12 defective pages are all detected except text over a gradient, which FL-06 assigns to the plan's axe run. The bootstrap writes the module to tests/browser/support/layout-assertions.mjs (integration). X15 requires every rule critical and executable, checks fixtures and composed patterns and the event-build copy, and has negative controls

findings.finding: IF41-SAVE could not drive automatic reconciliation reads, load reads or conflict reads; request bookkeeping unspecified
findings.remediation: ReconcileDue sends automatic reconciliation reads on the ScheduleReconcileRead timer (TimerKey); InterpretLoad and InterpretConflict with awaited-read state (LoadAwaiting, ReadingRemote of RequestId); RequestContext carries the tab-unique NextId (the engine advances it, at most one request per operation) and MutationInFlightElsewhere for T-S04/T-S53; operations record Outstanding; producer contract tests named for each

findings.finding: No frozen type kept the repository and credential after Connect
findings.remediation: IF41-WIRE ConnectionContext (repository, branch, opaque credential) kept in Model.Context and passed in RequestContext; persistence adds the Authorization header with Credential.authorization; producer test CredentialOnlyInAuthorizationHeader

findings.finding: The §46 note asserted a dependency direction v4.1 inverts

findings.remediation: ODR-V41-06 quotes 'the repository starts empty', 'code starts at kickoff' and 'keep competition application source code out of it', and says the T10 bootstrap makes the repository non-empty before kickoff

findings.finding: Credential readable from any Causa.App file; Saved after a load needed a forged Confirmation
findings.remediation: Credential is a module type with private representation (CI negative ReadCredential.fs refused with FS1093); Saved carries SavedBasis (Confirmed of Confirmation.T, or VerifiedAt for a load or confirmed discard, subject to ODR-V4-08)

findings.finding: X02 accepted contributors on integration files and a dropped boundary script; X04 trivial outcomes; X15 without controls; CI step name
findings.remediation: X02 rejects contributors on integration-exclusive files and requires the essential shared files in the manifest; X04 requires stated outcomes; X15 controls added; the step names X01-X15

findings.remediation: README, the report and AGENT-RULES state it is the .NET skeleton (plus the layout module); package references, integration's other shared files and test-framework wiring come at T10 (ODR-V41-07)

findings.finding: T19 and T22 estimate basis

ownerAdjustments.bootstrap: achieved for an empty directory; git-initialised directory refused (RV41-4-4)

findings.finding: The layout assertions missed common violations of their invariants
findings.remediation: Overflow checks include html and body and any content past the viewport; clipping compares each text range with its clipping ancestors; line length measures running text anywhere; dialogFocus fails when the invoker does not open the dialog (only a declared show-modal command is carried out in a browser without invoker commands); indicatorComposed is scoped to the header carrying the lozenge and checks order; faultStatesPreserved rejects statements that work was lost; contrast accounts for ancestor opacity and waits for entry animations; also skip link visible on focus, ring contrast, hidden scroll bars, late animations, empty navs, clickable non-controls, colour-only lozenges, unreadable linked stylesheets. 46 broken pages; the reviewer's 18 defect pages are all caught except two that do not violate the rule at that viewport or with Forma's ring

findings.finding: X15 did not enforce per-invariant coverage
findings.remediation: Each rule lists its invariants and the assertions that test each; X15 fails if an invariant's assertion is not run or a run assertion tests no invariant; negative controls added

findings.finding: No frozen contract drove SM-CONNECTION
findings.remediation: IF41-ERRORS Connector (ConnectRequest, InterpretConnect -> ConnectResult; write access only from stated permissions, EXT-DATA-005); ConnectionState Connecting of RequestId; producer test WriteAccessOnlyFromPermissions

findings.finding: --bootstrap refused a git-initialised repository
findings.remediation: A .git directory is allowed; CI now runs git init before the bootstrap

findings.remediation: The report names all three groups, including the published event rules

ownerAdjustments.executableLayoutTests: partly: about half of common real defects missed (RV41-5-1)

findings.finding: The layout assertions still missed about half of a wider set of real defects (50 of 95), and the round-4 record overstated coverage ('measures running text anywhere' was then false)
findings.remediation:
Shared in-page helpers judge what is actually painted (the background beneath an element on screen, real visibility, visible text, clipping ancestors). The assertions now cover:
• line length for any element with 80+ characters of its own text;
• focus rings clipped by a container and rings without contrast;
• all border sides, switch tracks and SVG icons for non-text contrast;
• loaders announced by their own name or a live region;
• visible, uncovered lozenge text;
• amber in SVG fill, shadows and gradients;
• `::-webkit-scrollbar` hiding, skip links hidden by clip-path or transparent text, and controls skipped by script;
• script-driven motion, sampled over time;
• async focus moves after a dialog closes;
• disabled or hidden fault actions;
• text over sibling backgrounds, input values and placeholders;
• contain: paint and clip-path clipping;
• colour-only markers, covered indicators, and off-screen, aria-hidden or unlabelled navs;
• custom menus beside the Forma shell;
• adopted stylesheets and @property.
On the reviewer's 110 runs, 96 are caught; the 14 others are 13 non-violations and the disclosed gradient case. 69 broken pages. R41-11 lists the remaining limits

findings.finding: Conflict was still an ambiguous union case (Decision and SaveState)
findings.remediation: SaveState requires qualified access; 99-Usage.fs matches Decision.Conflict and builds SaveState.Conflict; X04 rejects any case name shared by two unqualified unions across the contracts, with a negative control

ownerAdjustments.executableLayoutTests: partly: undisclosed misses, colour misreads, hidden Forma gaps and false failures (RV41-6-1..4)

findings.finding: Common real defects were still missed and not disclosed (RV41-5-1 still open): line length measured per inline fragment, loaders accepted any live region, text clipping excused by any label, motion in pseudo-elements, and others
findings.remediation: lineLength groups a block's text rectangles by line; loadingAnnounced requires the loader's own name, aria-describedby or a live region with loading words in the same busy region; textNotClipped is excused only when a label carries the clipped text; reducedMotion reads ::before and ::after and smooth scrolling; focusVisible tabs through every focusable element and fails a covered focused element; dialogFocus waits 1000 ms; the skip link's target must be displayed; touchTargets looks inside open shadow roots; scroll regions fail transparent or under-4 px bars; contrast covers filter: opacity() and ::before/::after text; fault actions must take pointer input and not be covered; "kept nothing" counts as a loss; a <details> link menu beside the shell is a custom menu; axe-core 4.14.0 runs as axeClean (FL-06e) on every reuse pattern in light and dark. Measured (Chromium; a defect is caught when any assertion of its rule fails): round 6's 127 runs, 114 caught, 11 of the rest are not violations on Forma and 2 are the disclosed click-handler miss; round 5's 110 runs, 96 caught, 12 not violations, 2 disclosed (gradient, row-reverse). 81 broken pages. R41-11 lists every known miss

findings.finding: The colour parser misread color(srgb ...), oklch and color-mix results in both directions (wrong passes and wrong failures)
findings.remediation: Every colour is normalised by painting it on a 1x1 canvas and reading the pixel, in both helper copies; amberLabelled compares text, background, border and outline colours through the same function

findings.finding: Forma gaps were hidden because each assertion ran on a hand-picked pattern list, not the contract's reuse patterns
findings.remediation: touchTargets, noHorizontalScroll, scrollRegionsAccessible, textNotClipped, textContrast (light and dark), axeClean (light and dark) and onlyFormaTokens run on all 44 reuse patterns at VP-320 and VP-DESKTOP. Nine Forma gaps are recorded (links shorter than 44 px in navigation-shell, cluster, diagram, landmark-region, record-header, relationship-index, sidebar, validation-summary and workspace-shell) with one token-only remedy covering every link; CI checks each raw pattern still fails and each remedied pattern passes. Forma's documented hook properties (inline --ef-* on diagram nodes) are in the inventory and allowed

findings.finding: statusVisible failed correct Forma pages (any lozenge below the fold, an empty role=status in the form pattern)
findings.remediation: statusVisible judges only the save indicator: the record header's lozenge (or the first lozenge) and the operation status or conflict review. Composed positive pages: record-header + operation-status + timeline, + form, and record-header + conflict-review + data-grid

findings.finding: Smaller false failures and misses: title-named scroll region rejected; shadow DOM, transparent and 1 px scroll bars, display:none skip target, filter: opacity and pseudo-element text, amber outline, late dialog focus moves, 1 px status text
findings.remediation: Each fixed as listed under RV41-6-1 and RV41-6-2; a title names a scroll region; master-detail's region with focusable content is accepted as axe does. Each defect is now a broken page that must fail in CI

ownerAdjustments.review: not achieved: major findings in the round-6 remediation
ownerAdjustments.executableLayoutTests: not achieved under the owner's bar: false failures (RV41-7-1, -2), undisclosed misses (-3, -5, -6), unreproducible catch rate (-4)

findings.finding: faultStatesPreserved failed correct pages with the copy PERSIST-031 requires ("could not save", "cannot be saved", a diff line saying another writer removed something)
findings.remediation: It reads only the fault's own message (not actions, diffs, code or tables), split into sentences per block. "Exists only in this tab" and "nothing of this tab's change was written" count as preservation; loss is an explicit loss word, "kept nothing", "nothing was kept", "could not keep", or the user's changes being deleted, removed or overwritten. PERSIST-031's copy for save failed, offline, unsaved and conflict (with a diff) are conforming fixtures; Forma's fault-banner, whose copy says "queued", is no longer a positive page for this assertion

findings.finding: navigationCollapses treated navigation carried by other Forma patterns (site header, landmark region, workspace shell) as a custom menu
findings.remediation: Navigation inside a Forma pattern that carries navigation is not custom (listed in the assertion and disclosed in R41-11). Composed positive pages: site-header + navigation-shell, navigation-shell + landmark-region, workspace-shell + navigation-shell, navigation-shell + record-header + sidebar. A custom menu is reported even on a page without the shell

findings.finding: statusVisible passed an indicator clipped out of sight by a container (hit test accepted an ancestor)
findings.remediation: Shared helpers shownRect (the part inside the viewport and every clipping ancestor) and onTop (the element at the centre of that part is the indicator or inside it). The indicator's full width and first 48 px must be shown; indicatorComposed uses the same test. D53, D54 and a clipped record header are broken pages

findings.finding: The published catch rate did not reproduce and counted failures of unrelated assertions
findings.remediation: layout-tests/catch-rate.mjs holds every review defect page from rounds 5-7 with its classification and reason; run.mjs --catch-rate counts a run as caught only when the defect's own assertion reports something other than a missing page element, and fails on an undisclosed miss or a failing conforming page. CI runs it. Measured: 224 of 230 violation runs caught; the 6 others are disclosed in R41-11. The stricter count exposed and fixed further misses: dialogs opened from click handlers or with role=dialog, danger callouts as faults, "gone" as loss, a custom menu on a page without the shell, text-only containers that clip instead of scrolling

findings.finding: touchTargets missed small controls with widget roles (option, radio, treeitem and others) using roving tabindex or activedescendant
findings.remediation: The selector includes option, radio, treeitem, menuitemradio, menuitemcheckbox, link and focusable gridcell whatever their tabindex; the listbox and roving radio group are broken pages

findings.finding: The contract's link remedy (inline-flex) switched lineLength off for paragraphs with links
findings.remediation: inline-flex, inline-grid and inline-table children count as inline; the remedied paragraph is a broken page

findings.finding: The optimization report stated stale coverage counts and stopped at round 5
findings.remediation: Counts corrected (23 invariants, 23 assertions, 88 broken pages) and rounds 6 and 7 added. X15 now fails when the report's stated coverage differs from the contract and kit, with negative controls

findings.finding: faultStatesPreserved accepted "queued", which PERSIST-032 forbids
findings.remediation: "Queued" is not preservation; a queued message is a broken page

findings.finding: statusVisible and indicatorComposed took the first operation status anywhere on the page as the indicator
findings.remediation: The indicator is found in the header region: the header and the two elements after it (or, without a header, the first on the page)

ownerAdjustments.executableLayoutTests: not achieved: false failures RV41-8-1..5; the catch rate reproduces with every miss disclosed

findings.finding: indicatorComposed required an operation status or conflict review in every save state, beyond PERSIST-030 (Saved, Unsaved, Saving and Offline have none)
findings.remediation: The lozenge names the state; an operation status is required in Unknown commit outcome and Save failed and a conflict review in Conflict, as PERSIST-030 says. FL-07's text and FL-07b are aligned with PERSIST-030. The Saved and Unsaved headers are conforming pages in catch-rate.mjs; round 5's and 6's "operation status below the fold" pages under a Saved lozenge are reclassified with that reason, and Save failed variants of both are caught

findings.finding: faultStatesPreserved called a lost connection, a gone commit or a discarded commit "lost work"
findings.remediation: Loss is counted only when its subject is the user's work (changes, edits, work, draft, attachments, notes), in either voice; the reviewer's pages are conforming cases

findings.finding: indicator() took the first header with a lozenge, so a workspace or site header with a connection lozenge (PERSIST-033) was judged instead of the investigation
findings.remediation: The record header with a lozenge is chosen first; a plain header only when there is none. The site-header and workspace-shell pages are conforming cases and the indicator-below-the-fold page is caught

findings.finding: Unknown commit outcome announced with role=alert while still checking was judged a fault without an action or preservation statement
findings.remediation: An operation status saying the save may or may not have reached GitHub (still checking) is not a fault; disclosed in R41-11; the pages are conforming cases (a conforming page may lack the element an assertion judges, but must not fail)

findings.finding: dialogFocus could not find a dialog invoker whose handler is attached by script
findings.remediation: AGENT-RULES requires every invoker to declare its dialog (commandfor, popovertarget or aria-controls); dialogFocus also takes { invokers: [{ invoker, dialog }] } for a plan test; popover dialogs are found. The script-opened dialog is a conforming case run with that option

findings.finding: Two sibling navigation shells were reported as a custom navigation
findings.remediation: Every navigation shell is Forma's and each one's collapse is judged

findings.finding: faultStatesPreserved missed "dropped", "reverted" and "kept and queued"
findings.remediation: dropped, reverted and reset are loss words; a sentence with a PERSIST-032 forbidden claim (queued, saved or kept locally or on the device, saved or synced later, will sync) never counts as preservation and is reported

findings.finding: R41-11 said every review defect is a broken page
findings.remediation: Reworded: every defect page is checked in CI as a broken page (92) or through --catch-rate

findings.finding: The fault-banner paragraph split the Forma gap list
findings.remediation: Moved after the list

rounds.note: All of the reviewer's round-8 pages are in catch-rate.mjs. One of them, the full Save failed screen at VP-200-TEXT, is classified as a violation by the page: its record header alone is 796 px tall in the 800 px screen, so the freshness line and operation status start below it, which PERSIST-030 does not allow at 200% text. Running all pages also found and fixed: fixed-position text cut by the viewport (textNotClipped) and "kept locally and will sync" (faultStatesPreserved)

ownerAdjustments.review: not achieved: one major false failure
ownerAdjustments.executableLayoutTests: coverage achieved; merge bar not met (RV41-9-1)

findings.finding: faultStatesPreserved called correct sentences lost work: PERSIST-020's "are lost when it closes", "If you choose Discard, your changes are discarded", and another writer's deletions in a conflict review; R41-11 no longer disclosed false failures
findings.remediation: Loss is a past or present statement about the tab's own work (your, some, all or the last changes, edits, work, draft, attachments or notes); a sentence with a condition (if, unless, will, would, once, when it or you) or about another writer is not loss. The reviewer's pages are conforming cases. R41-11 again says wording outside the vocabulary may be misjudged either way

findings.finding: The not-a-fault exclusion skipped any operation status mentioning "checking", Save failed included
findings.remediation: Only an operation status headed Unknown commit outcome (or under a lozenge saying so) that says the save may or may not have reached GitHub is skipped; the reviewer's Save failed pages are caught

findings.finding: "All conforming runs pass" counted runs that return an absence result, and would have hidden an error
findings.remediation: An error on a conforming page fails; the summary and R41-11 state how many conforming runs return only a missing-element result (6) and why

findings.finding: FL-07 "lozenge and freshness only" could be read as excluding PERSIST-031's words and actions
findings.remediation: Reworded: no operation status or conflict review; their PERSIST-031 words and actions still appear

findings.finding: At 200% text a long title can push the indicator out of view, with no guidance
findings.remediation: FL-07 says the title uses Forma's heading size and a title that would push the indicator out is clamped with its full value in an accessible name

ownerAdjustments.executableLayoutTests: not achieved under the merge bar: FL-07b did not check FL-07's prohibition (RV41-10-1)

findings.finding: indicatorComposed did not check FL-07's prohibition: an operation status in Saving, Saved or Offline, a conflict review in Saved or Save failed passed
findings.remediation: The state is read from the lozenge. Saved, Unsaved, Saving and Offline fail with an operation status or conflict review in the header region; Unknown commit outcome and Save failed need an operation status and fail with a conflict review; Conflict needs a conflict review. The reviewer's pages are caught and are broken pages. Forma's raw composed pages (record header lozenge "Overdue") are replaced by one conforming page per save state built from Forma markup with PERSIST-031 words

findings.finding: The lozenge was not checked to name one of the seven states, nor the header to show exactly one
findings.remediation: indicatorComposed fails a lozenge naming no save state and a header with more than one save-state lozenge; disclosed in R41-11 that the state is read from the lozenge text. Round 9's page built from Forma's sample header ("Overdue") is reclassified as a violation with that reason

findings.finding: A Save failed operation status announced without role=alert was never judged by the fault assertions
findings.remediation: A Save failed operation status (by its heading, or the indicator's under a Save failed lozenge) is a fault however it is announced; the fault assertions share one finder. A conflict review is judged by faultActionable too, so one without actions fails

findings.finding: faultActionable failed an Offline banner with PERSIST-031's exact copy and no action; the faultOffline fixture added an undefined button
findings.remediation: An Offline fault needs no action (PERSIST-031); faultOffline has PERSIST-031's copy and no button and is a conforming page for faultActionable; disclosed in R41-11

findings.finding: A loss worded outside the vocabulary is missed (disclosed)
findings.remediation: The page is in catch-rate.mjs as a disclosed miss under the existing R41-11 entry

rounds.scope: The application of the owner's decisions ODR-V41-02..08 (APR-V41-OWNER-2) and the frozen-v4 CI job (#61)

findings.finding: Amendments to v4's machines were not limited to what the owner approved, and v4's machine safety checks were not re-run on the amended machines: an amendment into Saved without a confirmation, a second amendment, an unknown source or a decision of another kind passed every check
findings.remediation: X12 applies v4's W05 rule (Saved entered only by a confirmation, entersSavedOnlyBy) to the amended machines, requires amendment sources to be baseline requirements, requires the decision to be a state-machine-amendment request, and validates the accepted entries. The offline suite pins each selected option to the transitions its text adds (ODR-V41-08 A: exactly SM-SAVE Saving + MutationSent -> Saving) and requires every selected option to be applied. Negative controls for each case
findings.status: verified fixed in round 12 (the accepted entries are completed under RV41-12-3)

findings.finding: T-S61 conflicted with IF41-SAVE and v4's definition of MutationSent: no component produced the event, its guard was 'true' (any RequestId could overwrite Outstanding and leave a save stuck), its effect restated existing bookkeeping, and its sources were weak
findings.remediation: IF41-SAVE names the producer: the App runtime steps MutationSent when it hands the outstanding mutation (Awaiting MutationAnswer) to Execute. T-S61's guard is 'current' (its RequestId is the Outstanding request awaiting MutationAnswer), its effect changes nothing else (state, base head, Outstanding, unsaved changes), and its sources are PERSIST-006 and PERSIST-031
findings.status: verified fixed in round 12 (the producer's wording is completed under RV41-12-1)

findings.finding: amberLabelled matched Forma's light accent-primary (35.5 RGB units from the light warning token) and missed a nested dark theme, and its dark path was never run; the limits were not disclosed
findings.remediation: amberLabelled reads the warning token in each element's own theme and matches it within 12 RGB units (#E9A23B keeps 40); the conforming fixture adds unlabelled accent-primary and control-active marks; a broken fixture uses a nested dark theme; the assertion runs in light and dark; R41-11 discloses the tolerances. Mutation runs: without the token match the token fixtures pass; with a radius of 40 the accent mark fails
findings.status: verified fixed in round 12 for Causa's default themes (the remaining limits are disclosed under RV41-12-2)

findings.finding: No check stops web/causa.css from using the literal #E9A23B, and the conforming fixture still painted the lozenge #E9A23B
findings.remediation: The conforming fixture draws amber with the warning token beside its label; R41-11 discloses that no automated check reads the stylesheet for the literal and that the T16 review checks it

findings.finding: X16 did not fix which projects take the test tooling, its title claimed a comparison with the owner's record it does not make, ownerRecords had no negative controls, and the ODR-V41-09 path would fail ownerRecords
findings.remediation: testTooling holds one lock per decision; X16 requires testProjects to be exactly the test projects that host .NET tests, checks each lock's decision kind and approval and packages locked twice across locks, and is retitled; ownerRecords compares each lock with its own record and has negative controls (another version, an extra or missing package, an unrecorded approval, a lock no approval records)

findings.finding: Inline package versions conflicted with the planned Directory.Packages.props (central package management: NU1008)
findings.remediation: The bootstrap writes Directory.Packages.props with ManagePackageVersionsCentrally and the locked PackageVersion items, and version-less references in the test projects; the bootstrap builds with 0 warnings

findings.finding: The frozen-v4 job trusted a mutable tag and installed the SDK from HEAD's global.json
findings.remediation: The job fails unless the tag names c9dc556, and installs the SDK from the tag's global.json

findings.finding: Stale counts and texts: 1 unused event, 75 transitions, 97 broken pages, the requests' status, and a doc comment above the wrong function
findings.remediation: No unused event; 76 transitions (report and task-adjustments); 99 broken pages; the requests' status names the decided and pending requests; the doc comment is back above machineProject
findings.status: verified fixed in round 12 (other stale texts under RV41-12-5)

rounds.scope: The round-11 remediation (#61, merged as 421fda3 after this PASS)

findings.finding: MutationSent's producer was named only as 'the App runtime ... when it hands the outstanding mutation to Execute', a point IF41-APP does not have (Update is pure; Execute is synchronous); no file or test was assigned, and T-S61's effect ('record that ...') contradicted 'the session is unchanged'
findings.remediation: IF41-SAVE and the amendments name Engine.Update (src/Causa.App/Engine.fs, ui), which steps MutationSent in the same update that turns the mutation request into HostEffect.Http; T-S61's effect is 'none'; the docs state that a missing MutationSent changes no outcome and no test beyond T-S61's requires it
findings.status: fixed; to be verified in round 13

findings.finding: amberLabelled's literal radius of 40 contains Forma accents in the dark-restrained and dark-technical themes, and ::before/::after marks and accent-color are not examined; R41-11 did not name these
findings.remediation: R41-11 names both themes and colours (Causa uses the default themes) and that ::before/::after and accent-color are not examined; the assertion is unchanged, so its measured catch rate stands
findings.status: fixed; to be verified in round 13

findings.finding: The accepted entries were not tied to the option: replacing SM-LOAD, adding SM-CONFLICT or dropping the entry passed
findings.remediation: The offline suite pins the accepted machines per option (ODR-V41-08 A: exactly SM-LOAD), with negative controls for each case
findings.status: fixed; to be verified in round 13

findings.finding: A package could sit in the other manager's list (npm in NuGet or the reverse), and a recorded dependency-lock decision with no lock passed
findings.remediation: X16 rejects a scoped @x/y name in the NuGet list and an npm name that is not lowercase; the offline suite requires a lock for every operator-recorded dependency-lock decision (the ODR-V41-09 lock is now applied); negative controls for each
findings.status: fixed; to be verified in round 13

findings.finding: Stale or inaccurate documentation: 173 generated files (178), 266 single-owner files (270), 'package references come at T10', and the Directory.Packages.props note claiming no project file is rewritten
findings.remediation: The counts are corrected, the bootstrap line names the owner's test tooling, and the note says integration adds the dependency lock's other versions and their references in the source projects at T10
findings.status: fixed; to be verified in round 13

closure.note: Review closed after round 10 at the owner's direction (2026-10-30): the owner accepted the known limitations disclosed in R41-11 and asked for the package to be merged. A round-11 review was started on 08cacfd and stopped before it reported, so the round-10 remediation (and the later font-dependent classification, dbdcc80) has not been independently re-reviewed.
